name: ToolPix
summary: AI-powered productivity platform featuring image tools, PDF utilities, converters, and coding tools.
description: ToolPix is an all-in-one AI-driven productivity web platform built with Python, Flask, and modern web technologies. It offers tools for image processing, PDF manipulation, code utilities, and format converters.

content.text: ToolPix is a production-grade web platform developed to consolidate daily developer and creator utilities into a single, intuitive interface. Powered by Python, Flask, and custom AI APIs, ToolPix delivers fast and accessible file processing directly in the browser.

items: AI-driven image processing & conversion utilities
PDF compression, merging, and document tools
Developer utilities, code formatting, and converter suites
High organic search visibility and responsive web UI

content.text: Built using Python, Flask, JavaScript, HTML5/CSS3, and deployed on cloud servers. ToolPix achieved significant organic search traffic and user growth through target SEO optimization and clean user experience.

name: KallanCop
summary: Offline multiplayer social deduction mobile game published on the Google Play Store.
description: KallanCop is an offline multiplayer social deduction game developed using Flutter and Dart. Players take on hidden roles such as Cop, Thief, and Kingpin, using strategy, deception, and teamwork.

gallery.alt: KallanCop Google Play Store feature graphic

content.text: Inspired by traditional 'Cops and Robbers', KallanCop was designed to provide a fun, strategic offline multiplayer party experience that encourages social interaction and high replayability without requiring an internet connection.

items: Offline local multiplayer gameplay for social gatherings
Hidden role assignment (Cop, Thief, Kingpin)
Strategic deduction mechanics & interactive animations
Simple, mobile-optimized UI designed for Android

content.text: Independently designed, developed, and published on the Google Play Store using Flutter, Dart, Shared Preferences, and the Android SDK.

name: Climbo
summary: Browser-based physics puzzle racing game with hill climb tracks and realistic car physics.
description: Climbo is a free unblocked physics puzzle racing game where players navigate challenging obstacle courses using realistic vehicle physics, momentum control, and strategic environmental solving.

content.text: Climbo introduces physics-based mechanics that challenge players to think critically, control momentum, and solve environmental puzzles with ramps, bridges, and moving platforms directly in web browsers.

items: Physics-based vehicle movement & collision simulation
Progressive difficulty levels with environmental puzzles
Responsive controls optimized for desktop and mobile browsers
Fast loading experience with modern low-poly visual design

content.text: Built independently using pure JavaScript, HTML5 Canvas, CSS3, and Web APIs, featuring a custom physics and movement engine.

name: CodePix
summary: Interactive coding learning platform transforming programming education into a game-like experience.
description: CodePix simplifies the programming learning curve through structured learning paths, interactive coding challenges, and a retro pixel-art themed interface.

content.text: CodePix transforms programming education into an engaging experience. It combines beginner-friendly learning paths, hands-on coding challenges, and gamified progress tracking.

items: Interactive coding lessons & beginner-friendly learning paths
Hands-on coding practice challenges & gamified progress tracking
Retro pixel-art themed responsive educational interface
User community profiles and interactive coding workflows

content.text: Engineered full-stack using Python, Flask, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, REST APIs, and SQLite/MySQL database integration.

name: DVMA - Dementia Assistant
summary: A compassionate mobile app empowering dementia patients, caregivers, and admins with AI-driven assistance, task management, memory albums, and real-time safety features.
description: DVMA (Dementia Virtual Memory Assistant) is an innovative mobile application crafted to support individuals with dementia in navigating daily life, cherishing memories, and fostering connections with loved ones and caregivers. With intuitive role-based access for Patients, Caretakers, and Admins, DVMA delivers real-time notifications, AI-driven chat support, and advanced face recognition to uplift the well-being of dementia patients and their support networks.

gallery.alt: DVMA patient home page with tasks and memory tools
DVMA Gemini AI chat assistant for dementia patients
DVMA caretaker patient dashboard and monitoring
DVMA caretaker live location tracking of patient
DVMA admin system settings and API configuration

content.text: DVMA (Dementia Virtual Memory Assistant) is an innovative mobile application crafted to support individuals with dementia in navigating daily life, cherishing memories, and fostering connections with loved ones and caregivers. With intuitive role-based access for Patients, Caretakers, and Admins, DVMA delivers real-time notifications, AI-driven chat support, and advanced face recognition to uplift the well-being of dementia patients and their support networks.

items: Task Management: Create, edit, and track daily/recurring tasks with smart reminders
AI Chat Assistant: Gemini-powered compassionate prompts for memory support and task help
Memory Album: Add photos and notes to relive cherished moments
Family Management: Add contacts, set emergency numbers, and manage relationships
Location Sharing: Secure real-time location sharing with connected caretakers
Personal Diary: Private daily reflections with auto-save functionality
Face Recognition: AI-based family member identification using ML Kit
Connection Management: Handle patient requests and manage active connections
Patient Monitoring: View tasks, location, memory albums, and daily activity
Direct Communication: Calls and messages to patients for seamless coordination
Advanced Scanner: On-the-go family recognition for patient support
Live Tracking: Real-time patient location monitoring with safety alerts
Reporting System: Submit well-being or feedback reports to administrators
User Management: Edit, ban/unban users and caretakers with full control
Global Notifications: Broadcast or targeted alerts via OneSignal push notifications
Reports Dashboard: Review and resolve user-submitted reports and issues
System Settings: Customize API keys, support contacts, and app configuration
Analytics: Track engagement, user growth, and usage patterns

content.text: Built with Flutter & Dart for seamless cross-platform mobile performance, Firebase (Authentication, Firestore real-time NoSQL database, Cloud Storage) for backend infrastructure, Gemini AI API for intelligent compassionate chat assistance, OneSignal for push notification delivery, and ML Kit / Cloud Vision API for face recognition capabilities. The Firestore database uses a normalized schema with collections for users, caretakers, admins, connections, reports, and API configuration — designed for scalability and real-time sync.

name: Explore Together
client: B.Sc Computer Science Final Year Project
summary: Cross-platform mobile app transforming solo travel into a social, safe, and connected experience.
description: Explore Together is a cross-platform mobile application developed as a B.Sc Computer Science final year project. It transforms solo travel into a social, safe, and connected experience through matchmaking, real-time chat, and Gemini AI assistance.

gallery.alt: Explore Together mobile application interface preview
Explore Together Gemini AI travel assistant chat

content.text: Explore Together was developed as the Final Year Project for B.Sc Computer Science. It redefines solo travel by enabling travelers to connect, match based on interests and trip dates, and plan journeys collaboratively. Built with Flutter for seamless cross-platform performance, Firebase for real-time Firestore synchronization and authentication, and Gemini AI for intelligent travel recommendations.

items: Travel Matchmaking: Match users based on destination, dates, budget, and interests
Interactive Map: Filter trips by location, budget, and duration
Real-Time Chat: Individual & group messaging for seamless trip coordination
Gemini AI Assistant: Personalized travel Q&A and destination recommendations
Trip Sharing: Post travel photos, itineraries, and moments
Admin Tools & Analytics: Monitor user growth, trip metrics, and engagement

content.text: Engineered using Flutter, Dart, Firebase (Auth, Firestore NoSQL DB, Storage), Gemini AI API, Cloudinary media optimization, and OneSignal push notifications with modular architecture.
